2d0045b9.text:
A Report on the State of the Frostmane Trolls in the General Area of Dun Morogh

Prepared by Senir Whitebeard, Senate Special Envoy

The trolls situated in Dun Morogh are largely centralized in Frostmane Hold, a mountain cave on the western border. They have sufficient numbers to cause some concern, however, they seem more than content to stay in their cave. This is, no doubt, because they do not wish to incur the wrath of the dwarves again, and risk total extermination. Their actions can be considered territorial, if anything, and it is
2d0045b9.title: Senir's Report

1092|fc807fb6.name: Captain Rugelfuss
1092|fc807fb6.text: At ease, $R.  This is no time for formalities.  With the Alliance forces under attack, the protection of the Dwarven territories becomes even more critical.  The recent Trogg uprising poses a dreadful threat to the King's land.

11865|7022eed4.name: Buliwyf Stonehand
11865|7022eed4.text: Ye want to be trained in the use of a weapon, do ye?  Well don't stand there slack-jawed, speak up laddie!

1247|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Belm
1247|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

1253|a23f7e7e.name: Father Gavin
1253|a23f7e7e.text: Welcome, $c, to the Misty Pine. If you are weary from your travels, feel free to rest and warm yourself inside. And perhaps if you've some spare time, you could assist me in some tasks.

13084|554a4659.name: Bixi Wobblebonk
13084|554a4659.text: Well hi there!  Are you here to learn the proper technique of a new weapon?

1340|76d04af9.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1340|76d04af9.text:
Welcome to Thelsamar, your home away from home in Loch Modan!

Thelsamar is a nice place, but it's not all beer and salted meat for those who answer the call to duty!  If you're willing to face danger in the name of the Alliance, then read the poster outside the Thelsamar branch of the Explorers' League.

1343|5751dde2.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1343|5751dde2.text:
Well, if it isn't a young, bristling $c, no doubt drawn here by talk of my exploits in fields of battle!

No time for stories now, for there are great, important deeds that need doing!  So if you're looking for glory, then luck shines on you today...

1374|61386298.name: Rejold Barleybrew
1374|61386298.text:
Curse that Brewers' League!  They have access to all the best ingredients, while we're stuck here grubbing for grain and hops!

I really would like to give them some bitter tasting justice...

1572|04178a2e.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
1572|04178a2e.text: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

1681|d4740e3c.name: Brock Stoneseeker
1681|d4740e3c.text: The best miner has a firm grip on his pick, a stout heart in his chest, and thick, black dust in his hair.

2326|a28d29e1.name: Thamner Pol
2326|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

2352|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Anderson
2352|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

246848|93d3f9d1.name: Kirin Tor Guard
246848|93d3f9d1.text:
Greetings, $N. Welcome to the kingdom of Dalaran. 

There are restrictions in place while the city remains under construction. If you have important matters that must be presented to the Kirin Tor, you may speak with Arcanist Ginsberg in the overlook to the east.

246848|ae06472b.name: Kirin Tor Guard
246848|ae06472b.text:
It is still under construction and only a short walk up the northeast road. The Alterac mountains have brought unneeded attention from some wild creatures and our recent interest in Silverpine Forest has kept our patrols quite busy.

Some small rumors have even spread about a juvenile drake soaring over the mountains with a full eye.

257446|1e35c538.name: Teo Hammerstorm
257446|1e35c538.text:
The stone an' soil speak truer than any tongue, if ye quiet the clatter in yer heart long enough to hear 'em. 

If ye've the makings of a $c, I'll teach ye.

257597|32ab8342.name: Bruegs Kindleborn
257597|32ab8342.text: Out of the hottest fire comes the strongest steel.

257597|879e41ad.name: Bruegs Kindleborn
257597|879e41ad.text: To give light, one must burn.

258098|1605f087.name: Eldrun Stormbreaker
258098|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

258113|1605f087.name: Ingrid Dunwald
258113|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

264936|6ba63b30.name: Earthseer Farsen
264936|6ba63b30.text: On a clear day, you can even see Blackrock Mountain from here. It's both beautiful and terrifying at the same time.

268047|53fff4bc.name: Theramore Emissary
268047|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

269153|dab85bcc.name: Mountaineer Ylva
269153|dab85bcc.text: <The mountaineer clearly fought bravely before meeting her end at the weapons of the troggs.>

274781|3804779b.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|3804779b.text: Which class trainer might ye be looking for?

274781|ab5dd850.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|ab5dd850.text: Between Bixi and Buliwyf, there ain't many weapons they haven't had the pleasure of slashing or smashing an orc with.  You can find them hanging out at the Timberline Arms weapon shop if ye need some training.

274781|ce6a7b9d.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

274781|e6c8b4c9.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|e6c8b4c9.text: The seers of the old ways, aye I know 'em. The waters of The Forlorn Cavern are where ye can find Eldrun Stormbreaker, $C trainer fer the kin o' the elements.

352|035b100d.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|035b100d.text: Where is it ye would like to go lass? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

4256|d1bed30c.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
4256|d1bed30c.text: If you ask me, there's no greater profession than a miner.  And if you ask me, there's no greater miner than a $r!

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

836|b62f5856.name: Durnan Furcutter
836|b62f5856.text: I sell the finest cloth and leather garb this side of the valley!

8508|15b608c8.name: Gretta Ganter
8508|15b608c8.text: Lookin' to fish? Then you'll need the proper tools.

918|08830bac.name: Osborne the Night Man
918|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

918|a0b51800.name: Osborne the Night Man
918|a0b51800.text: You look like the type I should watch my coin purse around. Something I can help you with?

918|b0da17d0.name: Osborne the Night Man
918|b0da17d0.text: I got something for you, $N. Looks important.

308-complete.name: Jarven Thunderbrew
308-complete.text: For me? You're a true hero, $N!
308-complete.title: Distracting Jarven

78261-accept.name: Unknown
78261-accept.text:
<A note sits in the chest>

Hello, $N.

I desire a treasure known as The Horn of Xelthos, which is somewhere within Shadowfang Keep.

Venturing inside the keep usually calls for backup. However, for this job, a low profile is of utmost importance.

You must go alone.

I have a contact, by the name of Veenix, in the Stonetalon Mountains. He should be able to help you get past the courtyard gate. The rest is up to you. 

Return the horn here, and your payment will be sent soon after.

- C
78261-accept.title: The Horn of Xelthos

78261-complete.name: Unknown
78261-complete.text: <You place The Horn of Xelthos into the chest>
78261-complete.title: The Horn of Xelthos

78307-complete.name: Unknown
78307-complete.text:
<A note sits in the chest>

For $N. I'll be seeing you.

- C
78307-complete.title: The Horn of Xelthos

96055-complete.name: Reyna Stonebranch
96055-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Incense Candle. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96055-complete.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

96391-accept.name: Unknown
96391-accept.text:
<The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it. Earthseer Farsen needs to see this.>
96391-accept.title: Underground Map

96395-complete.name: Unknown
96395-complete.text:
My... Thane... he... rests... yes... rest.

Thank... you...

I... rest...
96395-complete.title: An Ancient Grudge

96395-progress.name: Unknown
96395-progress.text: <The ghostly figure stares blankly past you. Its mouth is moving, but only low inaudible rasps can be heard.>
96395-progress.title: An Ancient Grudge

96403-progress.name: Thom Filch
96403-progress.text: <Thom appears to absentmindedly rub his hands together as he looks at you.>
96403-progress.title: Important Heirlooms

98071-accept.name: Brewmeister Bilger
98071-accept.text:
Worked a bit o' a trade with the Dun Garok brew-kin. We're not the only ones missin' the vineyards of the Fallrook family, it seems! Most o' the best bottled years are long since drank, but we do have cases of the wine still in the cellars. 

Bring this case of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in the southeast and leave it with 'em by their gatherin' fireplace at the bottom of their fort.

In return, carry a sack o' the Homebrew Hops back with ye.

That keep is the closest thing to home around here!
98071-accept.title: Brewer's Trade
